findings.evidence: “Request: state the decision/action needed, accountable recipient, deadline with timezone” and “Before drafting, identify recipient, desired outcome, sensitivity, and facts supplied” are familiar communication anatomy. Most of Route by goal and Audience and accuracy checks is activation; the notification and evidence-provenance traps provide the stronger expert delta.
findings.fix: Compress standard request/FYI/status fields into a small template and consolidate repeated unknown-fact reminders. Keep the Slack-notification, monitored-escalation, provenance, and unsupported-business-claim traps as the core.

findings.evidence: The output evals cover stakeholder delay, async chat, an agenda, and unknown release details, but none exercises the technical-to-nontechnical translation branch or checks that an implementation change is not converted into an unsupported measured benefit.
findings.fix: Add a stakeholder-translation eval using an unmeasured change such as containerization or added monitoring. Assert preservation of the implementation fact, absence of invented performance/reliability metrics, and retention of supplied sources and time windows.
